rationale: Extend the existing governed publication-decision and authoritative-publication capabilities with bounded Bajaj My Health Care v2 product adapters for one already-reviewed lab/radiology co-payment assertion. The adapters reuse the existing conditional co-payment certification runner, resolve only the historical bound_not_published state, and carry certified component semantics into the structured publication contract without adding reasoning rules or product-level co-payment authority.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded or replaced.
authority_impact: No new insurance, recommendation, policy-instance, option-selection, or claim-payment authority is introduced. Publication is bounded to one certified assertion and retains the certification limitation prohibiting policy-specific option selection and claim-payment decisions.
